item.description:
### 19–20 August 2026 Highlights (private head‑of‑products)
**Gibraltar** • **Headline:** Gibraltar publishes Prediction Market Regulations 2026, effective 13 July 2026. • **What happened:** Gibraltar's authorities have formally carved out prediction‑market activity—including order‑book models like ours—from traditional betting regulation.
